ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: pqc_csr

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CAPABILITY0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Algorithm, parameter set, lane, SCA capabilities

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Enable, abort, zeroize and self-test control

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Idle, busy, done, error and locked status

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: COMMAND
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Current command opcode, parameter set, flags and tag

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMEOUT_HINT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Scheduling timeout hint, must not truncate standard algorithm

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY_HANDLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Opaque handle with full generation, owner and slot; type comes from trusted metadata

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CONTEXT_LEN
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: ML-DSA context length, valid range 0 to 255

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ERROR_CODE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Non-sensitive error category, never encodes secret-derived information

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt state, hardware set and write-one-to-clear

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_ENABLE

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_TEST

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ALERT_FATAL

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: PERF_CMD_COUNT

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: COMPLETION_COMMAND_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Completion record, written by hardware before DONE is set

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: COMPLETION_OUT_LEN
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Completion output1 length and error info

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: COMPLETION_INFO
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Completion non-secret diagnostic info and cycle count

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DOORBELL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Doorbell, write one to submit the captured descriptor

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY_SLOT_META
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Key slot metadata readback window, never exposes secret key bytes

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY_SLOT_GEN
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Key slot generation readback for stale handle detection

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: KEY_SLOT_DOMAIN
